_comment: Sample omo MCP config for embedded Claude Code agents. Copy to omo.mcp.json and edit, then point launches at it via spawn_agent_task({mcp_config:'./omo.mcp.json'}) or claude_relaunch_session({mcp_config:'./omo.mcp.json'}). Or set it as the default by exporting OMO_MCP_CONFIG=./omo.mcp.json.

vercel._comment: Set your Vercel token via environment, then uncomment.

omo-events._comment: Hypothetical: a server that exposes hq_query and the live event ring as MCP tools so the agent can read your Stripe / Gmail / GitHub state directly. Build at src/mcp/omo_events.js (not yet implemented).
